title: Policy
description: Severity-to-action mapping. See plans/003-policy-engine.md and meetings/2026-07-22-1214-plan-003-kickoff.md in the security-skill-workspace repo for design rationale. A policy is always complete (all 5 severities mapped) — there is no partial/deep-merge override, only wholesale replacement (see policy/README.md).

policyVersion.description: Version of this policy schema (semver). Bump when the shape changes in a breaking way.

actions.description: Every severity from finding.schema.json's severity enum must be mapped — no silent gaps. Fail loud (schema-invalid) rather than guess a default for a missing severity.

action.description: Fixed action set for v1, matching CONTEXT.md §9 plus 'none' for Info-level findings that shouldn't do anything.
